name: Shuffle 'N' Cut Worlds Celebration Event
prizesWon: 1x Pitch Black booster pack, 1x Prize Pack Series 9, 1x Pikachu MEP 93 World Celebration promo
notes:
5 rounds BO1 Swiss, Top 4 cut BO3.

R1: Yijie Dou — Alakazam Toucannon (L)
Couldn't find stadium to replace Nighttime Mine.

R2: Anthony Ting — Crustle (L)
Duskull and Psychic Energy prized. Tails on Crushing Hammers.

R3: Bye (W)

R4: Max Zheng — Dragapult Dusknoir (W)
Poor start, but opponent misplayed hugely to let me win.

R5: CJ Hewitt — Marnie's Grimmsnarl (L)
Close set, missed early energy attachment so forced to Crispin instead of Boss. Opponent found late-game Boss for game.

Post event reflection:
• Straight Dragapult might have run better given my matchups.
• I paired two strong players in R1 and R2 who both played decks to beat mine, so losing to them isn't so bad.
